item.title: NASA will return its moon rocket to the hangar for more repairs before astronauts strap in
item.description: By MARCIA DUNN CAPE CANAVERAL, Fla. item.title: Mexican army kills drug cartel leader, causes panic in some areas
item.description: The killing of the powerful drug lord “El Mencho” set off several hours of roadblocks with burning vehicles in Jalisco and other states. Such tactics are commonly used by the cartels to block military operations.
